newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital buys 4,086 housing units.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital buys 4,086 housing units.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust said Tuesday it had made acquisitions totaling $286.6 million in California, representing 4,086 multifamily housing units.
Most of the acquisitions were made in the last 10 months, the company said.
Of the total, the company said $74.9 million is expected to close in the fourth quarter, which ends December 31.
In addition to acquiring existing properties, the company said it is looking for land to develop new apartment projects.
The company said it plans to develop seven projects in California at a total expected investment of $208.6 million.
